SDP: streaming table.description: CREATE STREAMING TABLE … AS SELECT FROM STREAM

SDP: streaming table from files.description: Streaming table ingesting files with read_files (Auto Loader) (Databricks only, not in OSS Spark)

SDP: temporary view.description: CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW scoped to the pipeline

SDP: streaming table with expectations.description: Streaming table with CONSTRAINT … EXPECT … ON VIOLATION (Databricks only, not in OSS Spark)
body: CONSTRAINT ${2:valid_id} EXPECT (${3:id IS NOT NULL}) ON VIOLATION ${4|DROP ROW,FAIL UPDATE|}

SDP: expectation constraint.description: CONSTRAINT … EXPECT … ON VIOLATION clause (Databricks only, not in OSS Spark)
body: CONSTRAINT ${1:valid_id} EXPECT (${2:id IS NOT NULL}) ON VIOLATION ${3|DROP ROW,FAIL UPDATE|}$0

SDP: AUTO CDC flow.description: AUTO CDC INTO (formerly APPLY CHANGES INTO) — CDC into an SCD1/SCD2 target (Databricks only, not in OSS Spark)
body: CREATE FLOW ${2:customers_cdc_flow} AS AUTO CDC INTO ${1:customers}

SDP: append flow.description: CREATE FLOW … AS INSERT INTO — append into a streaming table
